assessment_objectives.objective: the developer of the system, system component or system service is required to identify the functions intended for organizational use.
developers and/or process owners are required to identify the ports necessary to operate their technology solutions.
developers and/or process owners are required to identify the protocols necessary to operate their technology solutions.
developers and/or process owners are required to identify the other services necessary to operate their technology solutions.
developers and/or process owners document and justify the business need for the ports, protocols and other services necessary to operate their technology solutions.
